name: FlightDate
description: Scheduled departure date, local at origin

name: Tail_Number
description: Aircraft registration that operated the flight (trimmed, upper-case)

name: DepDelay
description: Actual minus scheduled departure; negative = early

name: WheelsOn
null_rule: Structural null: cancelled or diverted flights

name: TaxiIn
null_rule: Structural null: cancelled or diverted flights

name: CRSArrTime
description: Scheduled arrival, local hhmm at destination

name: ArrTime
null_rule: Structural null: cancelled or diverted flights

name: ArrDelay
null_rule: Structural null: cancelled or diverted flights
description: Actual minus scheduled arrival; negative = early (outcome)

name: ArrDelayMinutes
null_rule: Structural null: cancelled or diverted flights

name: ArrDel15
null_rule: Structural null: cancelled or diverted flights

name: CancellationCode
null_rule: Structural null: flights that were not cancelled
description: A carrier, B weather, C national air system, D security

name: ActualElapsedTime
null_rule: Structural null: cancelled or diverted flights

name: AirTime
null_rule: Structural null: cancelled or diverted flights

name: CarrierDelay
null_rule: Structural null: flights that are not 15+ min late arrivals
description: Arrival delay attributed to the carrier

name: WeatherDelay
null_rule: Structural null: flights that are not 15+ min late arrivals
description: Arrival delay attributed to extreme weather

name: NASDelay
null_rule: Structural null: flights that are not 15+ min late arrivals
description: Arrival delay attributed to the National Airspace System

name: SecurityDelay
null_rule: Structural null: flights that are not 15+ min late arrivals

name: LateAircraftDelay
null_rule: Structural null: flights that are not 15+ min late arrivals
description: Arrival delay attributed to the previous flight of the same aircraft arriving late

name: crs_dep_min
description: CRSDepTime as minutes after local midnight (2400 = 1440)

name: crs_arr_min
description: CRSArrTime as minutes after local midnight (2400 = 1440)

name: is_operated
description: True when the flight was neither cancelled nor diverted

name: struct_null_cancelled
description: True for cancelled flights: their operating columns are structurally null

name: struct_null_diverted
description: True for diverted (not cancelled) flights: their arrival columns are structurally null

name: struct_null_delay_cause
description: True when the five delay-cause columns are structurally null (flight not a 15+ min late arrival)

name: dq_extreme_delay_24h
description: Data-quality flag: DepDelay or ArrDelay above 24 hours

name: dq_time_conflict
description: Data-quality flag: UTC block time differs from CRSElapsedTime, AirTime > ActualElapsedTime, ArrDel15 inconsistent, operated flight without ArrDelay, or cancelled flight with ArrTime

name: dq_duplicate_key
description: Data-quality flag: another row has the same FlightDate, flight number, Origin, Dest and CRSDepTime

name: dq_outlier_other
description: Data-quality flag: taxi time over 180 min, departure over 60 min early, elapsed time differing from schedule by over 180 min, or invalid distance

name: crs_dep_utc
description: Scheduled departure in UTC (origin time zone from airports_tz.csv)

name: crs_arr_utc
description: Scheduled arrival in UTC (arrival date inferred, overnight handled)

name: split
description: train (to 2025-09-30), validate (2025-10 to 2025-12), test (2026-01 to 2026-08), by FlightDate

name: arr_delay_min_capped
null_rule: Null when ArrDelay is null (cancelled or diverted)
description: ArrDelay clipped to train-period limits [q0.5%, q99.5%] for modelling; ArrDelay itself is unchanged (outcome)
